transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus target function, adapting the inherent `[T]` receiver to an explicit `slice: &mut [T]` parameter and naming the return.

Attached the generated `slice_start_mut_ptr(old(slice)@, ptr)` and `final(slice)@ == old(slice)@` postconditions to the target function; this records the contract under test and does not assume the target body.

Isolated the Rust body expression `self as *mut [T] as *mut T` in the target-local external function `rust_1_96_slice_as_mut_ptr_cast`; Verus rejects the cast when placed directly in the non-external target body, but accepts it inside this explicit source-backed raw-pointer/provenance boundary. The public target `as_mut_ptr` is not external_body and calls only that boundary.
